ROOT.scriptdef: if exists (select name from sysobjects where name = 'POS_EksportPowiazaniaFormPlatnosci' and type = 'P') drop procedure CDN.POS_EksportPowiazaniaFormPlatnosci;

CREATE PROCEDURE [CDN].[POS_EksportPowiazaniaFormPlatnosci] @rowVersion bigint, @pointOfSaleId int AS BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON; declare @dbts bigint = cast(@@DBTS as bigint)
select @dbts as [@RowVersion], ( select Kon_Lp as [@PaymentFormId], PFP_KARNumer as [@CashBankAccountId], 'false' as [@ShowByDefault], null as [@VoucherSortId], 'false' as [@ResetBalanceAtEndOfDay], 'false' as [@ExternalValidationRequired] from cdn.PicoStanowiska join cdn.PicoKonfig on PSa_PcKID = PcK_PicoID join cdn.FrmObiekty on FRO_FRMID = pck_CentrumId and Fro_GIDTyp=736 join cdn.konfig on KON_Numer=FRO_GIDTyp AND KON_Lp=FRO_GIDNumer join cdn.picostanowiskaformypl on kon_lp = PFP_FormaNr and PFP_PSaID = psa_id join cdn.pos_KarDoEksportu(@pointOfSaleId,0) on PFP_KARNumer = KarNumer where Psa_ID = @pointOfSaleId for xml path('PaymentFormAvailability'), type) for xml path('PaymentFormAvailability') SET NOCOUNT OFF; END
GRANT EXECUTE ON CDN.POS_EksportPowiazaniaFormPlatnosci TO CDNRaport
